sourceCopy.name: Overtime Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Overtime Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Estimate regular and overtime pay from your own hours, threshold, hourly rate, and multiplier. Free calculator; no account.
sourceCopy.intro: Enter your weekly hours, hourly pay, overtime threshold, and multiplier to estimate regular pay and overtime pay separately.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I calculate overtime pay?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: This calculator applies the threshold and overtime multiplier you enter: regular hours are paid at the entered hourly rate, and hours above the threshold use the entered multiplier.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The estimate runs in this browser. Inputs are not saved or uploaded.

fields.accuracyNote: Enter the threshold, multiplier, and pay rules that apply to your situation. The calculator does not assume a currency or determine legal eligibility.
fields.legalNote: No country or employer rules are assumed. This is arithmetic based only on your entries, not a payroll statement, legal advice, tax estimate, or guarantee of wages.
fields.privacyNote: Inputs stay in this browser tab and are not stored or uploaded.

actions.privacyNote: Names and pairings stay on this device.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this calculator apply a specific country’s overtime law?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It uses only the threshold and multiplier you enter. Legal rules can depend on location, job classification, agreement, and other details.

additionalFaqs.question: How is overtime pay estimated?
additionalFaqs.answer: Hours at or below your entered threshold use the hourly rate. Hours above it use the hourly rate multiplied by your selected overtime multiplier.

additionalFaqs.question: Does the estimate include taxes or deductions?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It shows gross arithmetic from the entered rate and hours, before taxes, deductions, bonuses, or other payroll items.
